info.title: CarePath API
info.description: Demonstration product. Synthetic data. Not for clinical use. Session cookie auth; mutating requests need an allowed Origin and the x-csrf-token header.

organizationSlug.description: Needed only when the account belongs to more than one organization.

csrfToken.description: Send as the x-csrf-token header on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

expiresAt.description: Absolute end of the session (12 hours after login).

idleExpiresAt.description: End of the session if no request arrives first (30 minutes idle).

path.description: Dot path of the offending field, empty for the whole input.

organizationSlug.description: Needed only when the account belongs to more than one organization.

csrfToken.description: Send as the x-csrf-token header on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

expiresAt.description: Absolute end of the session (12 hours after login).

idleExpiresAt.description: End of the session if no request arrives first (30 minutes idle).

path.description: Dot path of the offending field, empty for the whole input.

get.summary: Liveness and database reachability. 503 when the database does not answer.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookie.
End the current session and clear the cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in user, organization, role, permissions and CSRF token.
Roles and their permission keys, as stored in the database.
Patient directory with search, filters and sort in SQL. Roles without clinical.read get administrative rows.
Patient header. Opening it writes a phi.read audit event.
Today's session state, check-in due, unacknowledged plan change, this week's progress and the next appointment.
The current published plan version with change note and diff; plan is null when none is published.
Every published version with author, time and change note, newest first.
One published version, through the same serializer as the patient plan.

post.summary: Hide the plan-change explanation on Today for this version (REQ-TOD-02).

get.summary: Exercise sessions, newest first.

post.summary: Start a session on the current published version with today's exercises.

get.summary: One session with its plan version, activities, position and elapsed time.
Check-ins, newest first. Pain is patient-reported.

post.summary: Submit a check-in. Pain at the clinic threshold returns the contact notice and raises one review task.

get.summary: One check-in. A pain task's source link points here (AC-D1).
Weekly assigned versus completed sessions, patient-reported pain and goals.
The patient's clinic: name, phone, reply-time text and the emergency notice.

post.summary: Pause with the current position and elapsed time.
Resume a paused session at its stored position (AC-C1).

put.summary: Complete an activity with counts, or skip it with a reason (AC-C3).

post.summary: "Stop, this hurts": end as stopped_discomfort and request a pain report (AC-C4).
Finish the session. Every activity must be completed or skipped first.

get.summary: Work lists for the signed-in clinician's care-team patients; each count equals its list length.
Plan versions, sessions, check-ins and review tasks of one patient, newest first.
Who changed what in the record, from domain rows (not the audit log), newest first.
Exercise library with search and filters. Fictional content, not medically reviewed.
The organization's review queue, highest priority then oldest first. Rule-based; no score.
Every review task of one patient, newest first.
The plan draft with its author and update time, or `{ draft: null }` when the plan has no draft.

put.summary: Autosave the draft (care team only). Creates the plan in draft status when none exists.

get.summary: The draft rendered through the patient plan serializer (REQ-PLN-05), with the diff from the current version.

post.summary: Publish the draft as the next immutable version (care team only). A change note is required from version 2.
Assign a task to a practitioner (in review) or unassign it (open). Care team only.
Resolve a task with a note; it leaves the open queue and keeps its history (AC-D5).
Dismiss a task with a note (no action needed).
Mark a check-in reviewed by the care team; 409 when it already is.

get.summary: The organization's review rules with parameters and the demo-defaults notice.

put.summary: Enable, disable or change a rule's parameters. Later evaluations use the new values (AC-D4); audited.

post.summary: Create a patient account with an eligibility code, in one step; signs the patient in.

get.summary: Intake steps with answers and where to resume; completeness only for coordinators and admins.

put.summary: Autosave one step's answers. Saving the consent step records the consents.

post.summary: Submit the intake; the patient moves to awaiting assignment (AC-A2).

get.summary: Each consent type with its active row, and every change, newest first.

post.summary: Grant a consent at its current text version; audited.
Revoke an optional consent; audited. The required consent is withdrawn through the clinic.

get.summary: Active practitioners with their active caseload, for assignment.
The patient's care team with names and roles.

post.summary: Assign a primary therapist; the patient moves from awaiting assignment to active.

get.summary: The caller's conversations, newest first, with unread counts. Coordinators list every conversation of the clinic.
Messages of one conversation, newest first. Others see delivered messages only; the sender also sees queued and failed ones. A coordinator outside the thread reads it as an audited organization read.

post.summary: Send a message. It is created queued; a delivery job marks it sent, or failed with a retry.
Move the caller's read marker to now. Participants only.
Try a failed message again. Only its sender can; it goes back to queued and a new delivery job is enqueued.
Book an open slot. 409 booking_conflict when the slot was just taken or the patient is busy then.

get.summary: A patient's appointments: upcoming (soonest first) or past and cancelled (newest first).

post.summary: Cancel a coming booking. The slot opens again in the same transaction.
Move a coming booking to another open slot: cancel and book in one transaction. If the new slot is taken, the original stays.

get.summary: Open future slots of one practitioner, grouped by clinic-zone day. Patients see only their care team's practitioners.
One practitioner's appointments on one clinic-zone day, every status, by start time (CR-1).

One patient's record as a FHIR R4 collection Bundle (Organization, Practitioner, Patient, Appointment, Encounter for visits that took place, Condition, Goal, CarePlan per published version, Observation, DocumentReference per signed note version; drafts are never exported). US Core-aligned shapes, validated by CarePath's defined checks before it is sent.

post.summary: Validate a FHIR R4 Bundle (collection, transaction or batch) with three layers and import its Practitioner, Patient, Encounter (AMB and VR visits), Condition, Goal, CarePlan and Observation resources into the caller's organization. Other resource types, including Appointment and DocumentReference (export only), are skipped and listed. 400: not a Bundle or structurally invalid; 422: CarePath checks fail; 409: duplicates with onDuplicate=reject; failures answer with an itemised OperationOutcome and write nothing.

get.summary: AI generations of a patient, newest first, failed ones included, with review state.

post.summary: Generate a clinician progress summary over the last windowDays. Refused (409 ai_consent_required, audited) without the patient's AI consent. A failed generation is stored and answered 502 ai_generation_failed with a Location header.
Generate a SOAP note draft from a visit's synthetic transcript. Approval later creates a draft note; nothing is signed or added to the record here.

get.summary: One generation with statements, each source reference resolved now inside this patient and organization, missing information, revisions, decision and approval blockers.
The record behind an evidence reference, only when it belongs to this patient (otherwise 404 and a security event). Audited as phi.read.

post.summary: Record an edit: change, remove, acknowledge (keep with a note) or restore statements, or acknowledge missing information. Appends a revision; earlier revisions and the generated text are kept.
Record that the reviewer opened a source cited by a statement (CR-7). Appends a revision carrying the current state forward; no base revision is needed. Read the record itself with the sources route.

The one decision: approve the draft as revised. Refused (409 ai_approval_blocked) while unsupported statements are unresolved. For a note draft, creates a draft ClinicalNote authored by the approving clinician; it is not signed.
The one decision: reject the draft with a reason. Nothing reaches the record.

A new generation for the same request (summaries cover the same number of days up to now), linked to this one by previousGenerationId. This one and its review history are kept. Refused once this one is approved.

get.summary: Visits that took place, newest first, with whether a synthetic transcript exists and the notes written for each.
Clinical notes of a patient, newest first, drafts and signed.
One clinical note with every version, oldest first.

post.summary: Append a working version to a draft note, by its author. Earlier versions are never changed. Signed notes take amendments only (amendments route).
The author signs the version they read. The only way a note becomes signed; approval of an AI draft never signs.
Amend a signed note: the author creates and signs the amendment in one call, with a reason (CR-8, demo rule). The current version of a signed note is always signed.
Mark a signed note entered in error, with a reason, by its author or a clinic administrator (CR-8, demo rule). Irreversible; the text stays readable and the note is no longer exportable.
